2227.question: What is the best clarifying shampoo to remove color?
2227.sources:
[1] List Criteria: The best shampoos for clarifying hair. The best clarifying shampoo helps to clean hair thoroughly, removing all the built-up gunk that can accumulate on strands. Clarifying shampoos aren't usually for everyday use, but once in a while, detoxifying hair is necessary.
URL: http://www.ranker.com/list/best-clarifying-shampoo/makeup-tips

[2] The best shampoos for clarifying can help to remove all that nastiness, so your hair gets a fresh start. Clarifying shampoo can instantly transform drab, lifeless-looking hair into a shiny, bouncy mane.
URL: http://www.ranker.com/list/best-clarifying-shampoo/makeup-tips

[3] Best Answer: If it's permanent then you can't completely remove the dye from your hair, but you can fade the color, but some kind of color from the dye will still be in your hair. You'll have to cut it out if you want the color completely gone.
URL: https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20091213222536AAtXYEO

[4] The best clarifying shampoo helps to clean hair thoroughly, removing all the built-up gunk that can accumulate on strands. Clarifying shampoos aren't usually for everyday use, but once in a while, detoxifying hair is necessary.
URL: http://www.ranker.com/list/best-clarifying-shampoo/makeup-tips

[5] What to Expect. Clarifying shampoos effectively remove temporary hair color. They help fade semi-permanent, demi-permanent, and permanent hair color as well. Even though these products are not intended to remove permanent hair color, you can expect anywhere from a slight variation in color to a couple levels of lift.
URL: http://www.yourbeautyadvisor.com/2012/03/hair-color-too-dark-here-are-your-options/

[6] To get rid of build-up from your conditioner, treatments and styling products. Even if you love your regular hair products, it's helpful to occasionally work in a clarifying shampoo to remove any build-up—especially of silicone-based conditioners and if you use any hairstyling products (even dry shampoo).
URL: http://beautyeditor.ca/2014/03/13/clarifying-shampoo

[7] A good clarifying shampoo is non-negotiable. While not designed for everyday use, clarifying shampoos are perfect as a once-weekly treatment to completely strip your hair of any gunk or residue. They work perfect with a moisturizing shampoo.
URL: http://getgoodhead.com/6-best-clarifying-shampoos/

[8] Rating Newest Oldest. Best Answer: If it's permanent then you can't completely remove the dye from your hair, but you can fade the color, but some kind of color from the dye will still be in your hair. You'll have to cut it out if you want the color completely gone.
URL: https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20091213222536AAtXYEO

[9] A good clarifying shampoo is non-negotiable. While not designed for everyday use, clarifying shampoos are perfect as a once-weekly treatment to completely strip your hair of any gunk or residue.
URL: http://getgoodhead.com/6-best-clarifying-shampoos/

[10] Remove Excess Hair Color Q: I understand there is a shampoo that I might use to lighten my hair that I have just colored too dark. Do you have its name? I would be most appreciative.
URL: http://www.hairfinder.com/hair4/clarifying-shampoo.htm

723515.question: Which product type is best for teeth whitening?
723515.sources:
[1] Go Smile Smile Whitening Light System. The Results: This top-scoring device really does whiten teeth in just 30 minutes. Testers ranked it the least likely to cause tooth sensitivity and the best of the high-tech devices at whitening. Still, some found the process of holding the light up to their mouths a bit tedious. Testers said: No bad aftertaste, and not a gross feeling in my mouth while in use..
URL: http://www.goodhousekeeping.com/beauty-products/teeth-whitening-product-reviews/g518/best-at-home-tooth-whitening/

[2] Tooth whitening lightens teeth and helps to remove stains and discoloration. Whitening is among the most popular cosmetic dental procedures because it can greatly improve how your teeth look. Most dentists perform tooth whitening. Whitening is not a one-time procedure.
URL: http://www.colgate.com/en/us/oc/oral-health/cosmetic-dentistry/teeth-whitening/article/tooth-whitening

[3] Q. Teeth Whitening Products With Peroxide. A. It’s important to learn about the whitening ingredient in the leading teeth whitening products when comparing whitening methods to determine which may work best for you. Hydrogen Peroxide is a popular ingredient in whitening products and is the whitening ingredient in Crest 3D White Whitestrips.
URL: https://crest.com/en-us/oral-care-topics/whitening/how-to-choose-the-best-teeth-whitening-product

[4] The Best tooth whitening is the one that works for you. Modern Dentistry allows Dentists many ways to whiten teeth. The differences include: speed, cost, comfort, fit, design, taste... Your Dentist should be familiar with various systems and depending on your goals, should be able to find the right fit for you.
URL: https://www.realself.com/question/the-recommended-product-for-trays-for-teeth-whitening#!

[5] When looking for teeth whitening products that work for you, it’s important to first understand your unique whitening goal, as well as how the whitening ingredient in the leading products works. If you have concerns, consult a dentist prior to starting treatment.
URL: https://crest.com/en-us/oral-care-topics/whitening/how-to-choose-the-best-teeth-whitening-product

[6] They are all effective. The ingredient with the longest track record is Carbamide peroxide. It comes in 5%, 10%, 15% and even 35%. The higher the percentage the faster the teeth whiten but the more sensitivity can develop. 35% is designed to be used for 30min a day.
URL: https://www.realself.com/question/the-recommended-product-for-trays-for-teeth-whitening#!

[7] Another step up in both cost and potency is dentist supplied “tray-and-gel systems,” which contain hydrogen peroxide in the 10% to 15% range and can cost several hundred dollars. After custom fitting your mouth with a mold, your dentist supplies a take home tray and whitening gel for you to use at home.
URL: http://time.com/3636232/teeth-whitening/

[8] This is a question that I'm asked all the time, but for take home tooth whitening, there really is no one best system. All take home tooth whitening systems have basically similar active ingredients (often carbamide peroxide) with the differences being flavorings, thickeners, etc.
URL: https://www.realself.com/question/the-recommended-product-for-trays-for-teeth-whitening#!

[9] So if your teeth are seriously stained, a whitening toothpaste alone won’t get the job done—no matter how hard you brush. (In fact, brushing forcefully can damage your gums and is never advisable, Messina warns.) Over-the-counter gels or strips are the next level up on the hydrogen-peroxide/price spectrum.
URL: http://time.com/3636232/teeth-whitening/

URL: http://www.goodhousekeeping.com/beauty-products/teeth-whitening-product-reviews/g518/best-at-home-tooth-whitening/

1151893.question: What is the best welder for auto sheet metal?
1151893.sources:
[1] Welding thin metal demands tight fit-up. Imagine a butt weld on 20 ga. metal. If the parts fail to touch for even 1/16 in., you have just created a hole that begs for burn-through and left a gap that cannot absorb the heat. On thicker metal, the edges of the metal can support the arc, but not here. Gaps cause nothing but trouble.
URL: https://www.millerwelds.com/resources/article-library/successfully-welding-sheet-metal-with-mig-and-tig

[2] I'm about to be welding a lot of sheet metal on my. project and I need to find a good/cheap smaller welder. I've got a Miller 251 mig but it just doesn't seem to like. to be dialed down low enough to weld sheet metal. I tried .025 wire and lots of different settings but it. just seems that the welder is too big.
URL: https://www.jalopyjournal.com/forum/threads/whats-a-good-welder-for-sheet-metal.409102/

[3] The most common welders used in auto restoration, therefore, are MIG (metal arc welders, gas or flux-cored), TIG (tungsten arc welders using shielding gas) and Arc Welders (the traditional stick electrode). To choose the most appropriate one for your needs, you have to consider the following parameters:
URL: http://secondchancegarage.com/public/150.cfm

[4] Sheet Metal Forming and Fabrication . A Tip for Successfully MIG Butt Welding Light Gage Sheet Steel. Useful Basics. Making strong, attractive MIG butt welds in body panels is essential to doing great panel work, unless you’re blessed with an expensive TIG weldor and the skill and experience to use it effectively.
URL: https://www.cartechbooks.com/techtips/mig-butt-welding/

[5] First off, never overlap seams, always butt weld. Second, never stitch weld, you'll warp the panels beyond repair. The proper way to do this is to do a series of tack welds that are quickly quenched, not by water, but with an air nozzle. Whether we are replacing a body panel with a new aftermarket piece from Year One or a used part from a donor car, the process is the same.
URL: http://musclecarrestorations.com/articles/tech/metal-work/welding-sheet-metal.html

[6] For the money, it’s likely the best welder for sheet metal. Sheet Metal Welder Buying Tips • A MIG welder is a good sheet metal choice. Stick welders, TIG welders and others welders all have the ability to weld sheet metal but those in the know concede that a MIG welder is best for that job in most cases. MIG welders are easy to work with, do most sheet metal jobs rapidly, and leave a nice finished product too. They are also the simplest type of welder for beginners to do good sheet metal welding with.
URL: http://www.mechanicalcaveman.com/best-welder-for-sheet-metal-review/

[7] Re: cheap welder for sheet metal in reply to 135 Fan, 01-13-2011 10:57:25 I second that. A friend of mine who has a full time frame straightening shop bought one of the cheap 115 volt, flux core units.
URL: http://www.yesterdaystractors.com/cgi-bin/viewit.cgi?bd=toolt&th=282095

[8] Some of the spot welders used in repair and restoration do not squeeze the weld area between two electrodes, but apply spot welding force and heat to one piece of metal that is grounded through the other piece to be joined to it.
URL: https://www.musclecardiy.com/bodywork/automotive-bodywork-how-to-weld-body-metal/

[9] Thank you so much for the tips on how to weld sheet metal. I really like how you made some modifications to the instructions when you found a way to weld that would be easier for the reader. I will have to try it out on my car that I am building.
URL: http://www.speedhunters.com/2014/03/the-101-how-to-weld/

[10] Weld Technique. Direct the arc at the middle of the weld puddle. Normally, you would keep the arc on the leading edge, where the weld puddle is thinnest, to drive the arc into the work for more penetration. However, staying back enables the puddle to insulate the base metal from the arc's full force.
URL: https://www.millerwelds.com/resources/article-library/successfully-welding-sheet-metal-with-mig-and-tig
